name: Jordan Hollandaise
source:
Pearl's cousin and also a long-time friend with Reggie.

The epitome of a contrarian, even though everyone calls her out on it. She dishes it out as well as she takes it. Jordan loves watching and quoting movies, and was a popular video blog personality on her channel, HoarseFeed. Taken in by the Moira family after her parents passed away.

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrtired/undead-darlings-a-visual-novel-rpg-for-pc-and-ps4]Kickstarter[/url] page]
